hand_coded_svg_diagrams: CRT Cross-Section (Electron Gun, Focusing Anode, Deflection Plates, Phosphor Screen, Electron Beam)
Raster Scan Display (Horizontal Trace, Refresh Lines, Vertical Retrace)
Random Scan / Vector Display (Directed beam plotting a crisp triangle path)
RGB Color Cube / Additive Mixing Circles (Red, Green, Blue overlapping light to produce Cyan, Magenta, Yellow, White)
CMY / CMYK Subtractive Color Mixing (Cyan, Magenta, Yellow light subtractive overlays to Black)
HSV Color Wheel & Hexcone Model (Hue Angle, Saturation Radius, Value Height)
DDA Line Drawing Pixel Grid (Grid with calculated integer pixel steps vs continuous line)
Scan Conversion Flow Architecture (Geometric primitives -> Rasterization -> Pixel Buffer)
